title: Germany–Korea Treaty of 1883
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Germany–Korea Treaty of 1883", at revision 1202030819, opens: "The Germany–Korea Treaty of 1883 was negotiated between representatives of Germany and Korea." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q800046, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1883 commercial treaty between Joseon-dynastic Korea and German Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
